notes.title: Version2.3 Enchanted Attribute Comparison
notes.content:
[p]Dear Inheritors：[/p][p align="start"]In this Designer's Note，we present a comprehensive comparison of the effects of demise level soul core enchantments in version 2.3: [b]Penetration、Skill Atk、Soul core Skill Atk and Crit Dmg[/b].[/p][p align="start"]Packed with valuable insights—your likes, shares, and comments are welcome![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45149847/50064cc18418877b9c820e98ad1bc816e7859e51.png"][/img][/p][p]In the current Version 2.3 environment, a stable consensus has gradually formed regarding the choice among four dps Soulcore enchantments: Demise Breach Soulmark (Penetration), Demise Nirvana Soulmark (Skill Attack), Demise Formless Soulmark(Soulcore Skill Attack), and Origin Soulmark(Critical Damage).[/p][p align="start"]The following conclusions are based on the premise of "12 fully enchanted Soulcore" and "character critical rate exceeding 100%", covering multi-scenario testing including Timber Pile, Astral Expedition, and Circle Expeditions, and can be directly referenced by Inheritors for enchantments and gear configuration.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45149847/555ef4ee95a345390d0e0a1c89964ed9b5e06833.jpg"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45149847/4a4b64dac520fa9bafc4da2a9f0918c842f8e3ab.jpg"][/img][/p][p][i]【Testing Gears】 New gear recommendations for Version 2.3 (cite when released)[/i][/p][p align="start"][i]【Testing Skills & Soul Cores】[/i][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45149847/26b2bec96924d5c99d84658277666d4df39eedc3.jpg"][/img][/p][h2][b]Enchantment Introduction[/b][/h2][p][/p][p][b]Demise Rupture Soulmark (Penetration)[/b][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45149847/f2ca7f2e3b369d92cadd5e9bf212fa2172eaaf76.jpg"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45149847/424bb96e0874335f89f68b03abdbeec78f202803.jpg"][/img][/p][p][b]Demise Nirvana Soulmark (Skill Attack)[/b][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45149847/6dc2ecd2aa62f1b4bf32b2ba7627c004ee5af357.jpg"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45149847/db2be0dec1441738b92ffcbc40aac2501515311e.jpg"][/img][/p][p][b]Demise Formless Soulmark(Soulcore Skill Attack)[/b][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45149847/ad5b5462912df8dd02bcc81677d3518cd12ed030.jpg"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45149847/f77226fc934d330c7755150f060ec481bd90e8a0.jpg"][/img][/p][p][b]Origin Soulmark(Critical Damage)[/b][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45149847/5d729810a4c0393c136e735f0a2b36d8b1c19690.jpg"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45149847/a280d3ae44e8acedfc4eaf17a7fe88e1a9509b3a.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][h2][b]I.Demise Breach Soulmark (Penetration)[/b][/h2][p]When penetration is exactly at [b]100%[/b], it provides maximum effectiveness against high-defense targets (especially Astral Expedition bosses). When below 100%, each point of penetration increases damage by approximately 0.16%-0.5%—the higher the target's defense, the more dmg increased. However, once penetration reaches 100%, any additional penetration will overflow and provide no further damage increase. Therefore, when optimizing for damage (particularly in Astral Expeditions), prioritize precisely stacking penetration to 100% through gears, enchantments, and runes, then allocate all remaining resources to other attributes.[/p][p][/p][h2][b]II.Demise Formless Soulmark(Soulcore Skill Attack)＞Demise Nirvana Soulmark (Skill Attack)：Primary choice / Secondary choice[/b][/h2][list][*][p]Demise Formless Soulmark boosts "Soulcore Active Skills", while Demise Nirvana Soulmark enhances "Normal Skill Attacks". In practical tests, under equal conditions, Demise Formless Soulmark provides [b]17%-20%[/b] higher total damage output than Demise Nirvana Soulmark.[/p][/*][*][p]After reaching the penetration cap, prioritize using Demise Formless Soulmark. If resources are insufficient, supplement with Demise Nirvana Soulmark.[/p][/*][*][p][/p][/*][/list][h2][b]III. Origin: Soul Sage Sigil (Critical Damage): A viable alternative with tangible value[/b][/h2][list][*][p]It falls significantly behind Demise Formless Soulmark ([b]24%-34%[/b]) and is not a priority choice;[/p][/*][*][p]The performance gap with Demise Nirvana Soulmark is minimal ([b]2%-10%[/b]). If Demise Formless Soulmark is insufficient and acquiring Demise Nirvana Soulmark is too costly, this can serve as a viable substitute with negligible perceived difference in damage.[/p][/*][/list][olist][*][p]Priority: [b]Penetration (capped at 100%) > Soulcore Skill Attack > Skill Attack > Critical Damage[/b].[/p][/*][*][p]Procedure: First, stack Penetration to 100%.Prioritize Demise Formless Soulmark for remaining slots.Use Demise Nirvana Soulmark as secondary option.Consider Origin Soulmark only as last resort.[/p][/*][*][p]Exceptions: If the enemy has low defense (e.g., in Circle Expedition) or your gear already significantly reduces defense, you may allocate less resources to Penetration and reallocate them to Soulcore Skill Attack instead.Allocating resources in this order will consistently maximize your damage output.[/p][/*][/olist][p align="start"][i][b]Note: For "Skill-focused builds" (with short cooldowns and high skill levels), the priority between Soulcore Skill Attack and Normal Skill Attack may change. Adjust your strategy flexibly accordingly.[/b][/i][/p][p align="start"]
Summary: Penetration must be stacked to exactly 100% and then stopped. Afterwards, prioritize Formless Soulmark first, with Nirvana and Origin Soulmark serving as supplements. Allocating resources in this order will consistently maximize your damage output.[/p][p align="start"]Exactly! You've officially mastered the optimization strategy![/p]

notes.title: 2025/08/28 Update
notes.content:
v2.3 Updated: Cursed Apostle

New Class: Hela the Soul Reaper
- The Abyssal Blade Wields: Redemption Through Destruction. Hela, the Soul Reaper, has been unleashed.

New Soul Core Series: Cthulhu Awakens
- Four new Cthulhu Soul Cores with two new affinities:
The King in Yellow + The Pope of Yellow Wind
The Highest Mother + The Sleeping Secret Daughter

New Treasure Hunt Gameplay
- Divine Demise
Inheritors can challenge Divine Demise solo, where Abyssal Overlord Modgud guards mysterious treasures.

New Soul Core: The Apostle of Silver Veils
- A new Physical-based, versatile Mythic Soul Core: ""The Apostle of Silver Veils"" is now available.
This Soul Core can equip a substitute Soul Core from the initial star level, inheriting part of its panel stat and second-slot passive skill.

New Soul Core Cultivation: Attunement
- The new Attunement Upgrade is now available for Soul Core cultivation, consuming Soul Core Fragment and Attunement Brightstone.

New Function: Skill Loadout
- Inheritors can apply recommended skill builds from the system or top players.

Cultivation
- Soul Core level cap increased to 150, advancement level cap expanded from 11 to 20, with no change in material costs.
- New Runes and Rune Whisper added.
- Optimized the strength of some Ice Soul Cores.
- New Mythic gear, Enchant items and new Immortal gear for exchange.

Gameplay Expansion
- Chapters Primglory 6-5 and Vortex of Origin 1-5 are now available.
- New Level 60 (60) Hero Co-op and Caravan Co-op dungeons added, featuring new gear, new Enchants, and more.
- Clearing the Vortex of Origin now grants new rewards: Soul Essence items.

Optimization
- Caravan: Added Caravan renaming and Leader transfer, and more Vice Leader slots.
- The screen will no longer turn off while the game is running.
- Added a ""Claim All"" feature for Daily Quest rewards.
...and various other improvements...

notes.content:
[p][img src="https://img2.tapimg.net/post/images/47d0f39e393bed02a74514cc90cbd993.png?imageMogr2/thumbnail/1080x9999%3E/quality/80/format/jpg/interlace/1/ignore-error/1&t=1"][/img][/p][p][i]The Old Ones whisper forbidden coordinates; the astral dust calls for an expedition...[/i][/p][p][/p][p]Since the 2.2 update, Inheritors have been continuously pushing high scores in the [b]Astral Expedition[/b] mode, proving their strength. At the same time, many have noticed that the boss [b]Darkvein Adiposer[/b] is far from a simple punching bag—Inheritors often find themselves dishing out damage but barely making a dent.[/p][p][b]To achieve a high score, it's crucial to thoroughly understand the boss’s combat mechanics and precisely time your damage strategy.[/b][/p][p][/p][p]In this guide, [b]Audhum[/b] will break things down from two angles: [b]boss mechanics[/b] and [b]character build[/b]. Hopefully, Inheritors will be able to glimpse a sliver of hope amid Darkvein Adiposer's relentless onslaught...[/p][p][/p][h2][b]BOSS Mechanics [/b][/h2][p][/p][h3][b]I. Time Mechanics [/b][/h3][p][/p][p](1) Upon entering the battle, you have a total of [b]300 seconds[/b] to fight. As time progresses, the boss becomes increasingly powerful. Every 10 seconds, the boss's [b]Attack[/b], [b]All Elemental Resistances[/b], [b]Physical Damage Reduction[/b], [b]Critical Resistance[/b], and [b]Critical Damage Reduction[/b] will gradually increase, reaching their maximum values [b]at 240 seconds[/b] into the battle. [/p][p](2) After [b]120 seconds[/b], characters will begin to suffer from a [b]stage debuff[/b], visually indicated by small blood droplets orbiting around the character. This debuff continuously drains a portion of both [b]HP and Stamina per second[/b], and it intensifies [b]every 30 seconds[/b], reaching maximum strength [b]at 240 seconds[/b].[/p][p][img src="https://img2.tapimg.net/post/images/2e680317175e22976d2012730a31fed4.png?imageMogr2/thumbnail/1080x9999%3E/quality/80/format/jpg/interlace/1/ignore-error/1&t=1"][/img][/p][p](3) Every [b]60 seconds[/b], the boss will [b]transform[/b], changing its appearance and releasing a [b]shockwave[/b] that spreads across the entire screen. This shockwave deals [b]true damage based on a percentage of its max HP[/b].[/p][p][/p][h3][b]II. BOSS HP Mechanics [/b][/h3][p][/p][p](1) The BOSS increases its resistance to all elements and reduces critical damage taken every time it loses [b]5%[/b] of its HP.  (2) When the BOSS's HP reaches the thresholds X99359, X98799, X97199, X93959, and X92559, it triggers [b]a damage-lock mechanism, unleashes a high-damage full-screen skill, and then changes part of its attack pattern[/b].[/p][p][/p][h3][b]III. BOSS Skill[/b][/h3][p][/p][p][img src="https://img2.tapimg.net/post/images/lmfFRdoXlWpMKfEAnWTUasPvfKql.gif?imageView2/2/w/1080/h/9999/ignore-error/1/colors/-1"][/img][/p][p][b]Claw strike on the ground in front, dealing Thunder DMG.[/b][/p][p]Threat: ⭐ [/p][p]Strategy: Stick close to the boss.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="https://img2.tapimg.net/post/images/FtIoOmD98BP7KUvQcJvV0_dQkHA9.gif?imageView2/2/w/1080/h/9999/ignore-error/1/colors/-1"][/img][/p][p][b]Smashes and sweeps the ground, dealing Ice DMG and applying a large amount of Ice status.[/b][/p][p]Threat: ⭐ [/p][p]Strategy: Stick close to the boss.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="https://img2.tapimg.net/post/images/Fj5r4ZX139LJndhdtsYiP-5PjBe7.gif?imageView2/2/w/1080/h/9999/ignore-error/1/colors/-1"][/img][/p][p][b]Double ground pound, dealing Poisonous DMG and status.[/b][/p][p]Threat: ⭐⭐ [/p][p]Strategy: Dodge or reposition to avoid it. If your HP is enough, you can also tank it using a skill with super armor.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="https://img2.tapimg.net/post/images/FsTIubAHyM6DsymbpJwTx5EM8Udt.gif?imageView2/2/w/1080/h/9999/ignore-error/1/colors/-1"][/img][/p][p][b]The boss throws a poison orb, dealing Poisonous DMG and status.[/b][/p][p]Threat: ⭐⭐ [/p][p]Strategy: When the boss pulls his left hand back, dodge. If your HP is healthy, you can also use a super armor skill to tank it.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="https://img2.tapimg.net/post/images/lmg9ZRB31JvJ8M5GIp59kXto1754.gif?imageView2/2/w/1080/h/9999/ignore-error/1/colors/-1"][/img][/p][p][b]The boss throws 3 Thunder orbs, dealing Thunder DMG.[/b][/p][p]Threat: ⭐⭐ [/p][p]Strategy: Get right up close to the boss — the Thunder orbs won't hit you.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="https://img2.tapimg.net/post/images/ltCi7BrPmYt6dbX3tRWAo5y8CfXO.gif?imageView2/2/w/1080/h/9999/ignore-error/1/colors/-1"][/img][/p][p][b]The boss claps his hands, dealing Ice DMG and status.[/b][/p][p]Threat: ⭐⭐ [/p][p]Strategy: Dodge or reposition to avoid. It's best not to tank this: once Ice accumulation maxes out, you'll be frozen, which forcibly interrupts your skill casting and breaks your attack rhythm.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="https://img2.tapimg.net/post/images/Fs_yqwgUgtgf7UHpTiBAQog9_9JC.gif?imageView2/2/w/1080/h/9999/ignore-error/1/colors/-1"][/img][/p][p][img src="https://img2.tapimg.net/post/images/lmL2EGyxOjIOvQVNqWJ0p0cJWMt1.gif?imageView2/2/w/1080/h/9999/ignore-error/1/colors/-1"][/img][/p][p][b]The boss summons two walls of fire in front. Characters who run into them receive Fire damage and status. When the boss’s HP falls below 98,800, the fire walls begin moving sideways.[/b][/p][p]Threat: ⭐ [/p][p]Strategy: Attack the boss normally; don’t blindly charge in.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="https://img2.tapimg.net/post/images/lkJEgZW9oEPthO_DYcE0P_E4zs4I.gif?imageView2/2/w/1080/h/9999/ignore-error/1/colors/-1"][/img][/p][p][b]The boss performs a large frontal breath attack, dealing Fire damage and status. [/b]Threat: ⭐⭐ [/p][p]Strategy: Dodge or reposition to avoid. If your HP is healthy, you can also use a super armor skill to tank it.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="https://img2.tapimg.net/post/images/listw2NQnDQrNt2zoGGPhsKiUzdh.gif?imageView2/2/w/1080/h/9999/ignore-error/1/colors/-1"][/img][/p][p][b]The boss punching the ground with fists, dealing Ice damage and status.[/b][/p][p]Threat: ⭐⭐ [/p][p]Strategy: There are six hits total. The first one has an irregular hitbox — when the boss raises its hand, it may graze you. It's recommended to dodge the first hit. For the remaining ones, just stay close to the boss and you won’t get hit.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="https://img2.tapimg.net/post/images/licxZZHD-hRy5sCuhqBfp4kSJ9QD.gif?imageView2/2/w/1080/h/9999/ignore-error/1/colors/-1"][/img][/p][p][b]Two thunder vortexes appear in the boss’s palms, converging toward the center. Once combined, they explode, releasing mini-vortexes outward. Characters touching the vortexes take damage.[/b][/p][p]Threat: ⭐⭐ [/p][p]Strategy: Avoid the path of the tornado's movement.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="https://img2.tapimg.net/post/images/lplOyAdt1YwtaWa1sZAwfg1pZeav.gif?imageView2/2/w/1080/h/9999/ignore-error/1/colors/-1"][/img][/p][p][b]Two Thunder vortexes[/b] appear in the boss’s palms, converging toward the center. Once combined, they [b]explode[/b], releasing [b]mini-vortexes[/b] outward. Characters touching the vortexes take [b]damage.[/b][/p][p]Threat: ⭐⭐⭐ [/p][p]Strategy: Watch where the energy orbs land and dodge or reposition accordingly.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="https://img2.tapimg.net/post/images/lr6VB7RtDcC8QyQ0w2BvZOL0cYtJ.gif?imageView2/2/w/1080/h/9999/ignore-error/1/colors/-1"][/img][/p][p][b]Continuous lightning strikes from the sky[/b], dealing Thunder DMG, and leaving [b]damage zones[/b] on the ground.[/p][p]Threat: ⭐ [/p][p]Strategy: Deal damage to the boss normally — this one can’t be avoided.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="https://img2.tapimg.net/post/images/lqVCq2csiGfSV5OGS4id2S5Wdk1x.gif?imageView2/2/w/1080/h/9999/ignore-error/1/colors/-1"][/img][/p][p][b]Triple chain[/b] [b]explosion, similar to bouncing projectiles, causing Fire damage and status.[/b][/p][p]Threat: ⭐⭐⭐ [/p][p]Strategy: Move or dodge toward the boss’s rear to avoid the first hit. For the next two, observe the trajectory of the falling shards and look for gaps to dodge or move through. Note: after each explosion, Fire damage will briefly remain on the ground — don’t step into it right away.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="https://img2.tapimg.net/post/images/lge6LMtkbmX3bOBqjtE_3Gom8vB3.gif?imageView2/2/w/1080/h/9999/ignore-error/1/colors/-1"][/img][/p][p]The boss [b]pounds the ground repeatedly[/b], each strike generating an [b]ice spike field[/b] in front, dealing [b]Ice damage and status.[/b][/p][p]Threat: ⭐⭐⭐ [/p][p]Strategy: There are six hits total. The first one has an irregular hitbox — when the boss raises its hand, it may graze you. It's recommended to dodge the first hit. For the rest, stay close to the boss and you won’t be hit. Also be aware that stepping on the icicles before they disappear will cause damage and increase debuff buildup.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="https://img2.tapimg.net/post/images/lknQF2_fbsuvivx6tcEuUTx0oijs.gif?imageView2/2/w/1080/h/9999/ignore-error/1/colors/-1"][/img][/p][p]The boss [b]releases a shockwave[/b] that [b]expands to full screen[/b], dealing [b]true damage based on a percentage of the character’s max HP[/b].  This is triggered [b]every minute[/b], following an on-screen boss dialogue.[/p][p]Threat: ⭐⭐⭐⭐ [/p][p]Strategy: Watch the warning — when the red ring expands to the outer edge, dodge or use your ULTRA to avoid it. The damage is very high; don’t try to tank it.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="https://img2.tapimg.net/post/images/lrNU3zIGYqZaKrLjSKzC0UnmFBY1.gif?imageView2/2/w/1080/h/9999/ignore-error/1/colors/-1"][/img][/p][p][b]The boss performs two consecutive ground slams, each dealing screen-wide true damage based on max HP and dealing Ice status.[/b]  [b]HP Lock Mechanism: Triggered when the boss’s HP hits X99359, X98799, X97199, X93959, and X92559.[/b][/p][p]Threat: ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐ [/p][p]Strategy: Watch the boss’s movement — when it slams down with both fists, dodge or use your ULTRA. The damage is extremely high and causes freezing; taking it head-on can easily get you killed. Note: during this move, the boss is in a locked-HP state. Your damage will be recorded in the stats, but the boss won’t lose HP, nor will you earn points — so just focus on dodging.[/p][p][/p][h2][b]Build Suggestions[/b][/h2][p][/p][p]Because the BOSS's various resistances gradually increase over time and as its HP decreases, once its resistance reaches 100%, it becomes immune to damage—any skill used on it will be completely negated. Therefore, reducing the BOSS's resistance in Astral Expedition is [b]essential for extending the damage duration[/b].[/p][p][/p][h3][b]I. Soul Core Build[/b][/h3][p][/p][p](1) The third Soul Skill of [b]Amorphous Eyes[/b] reduces the enemy’s all-elemental resistance by 10% at level 1, and up to 30% at max level, making it highly versatile across all elemental builds. Each elemental build also has its own suitable Soul Cor; like [b]Frostwurm Cthylla (Ice)、Solemn Brynhild (Fire)、Lezard. The God of The Moon (Poisionous)、Thor the God of Thunder (Thunder)[/b]。[/p][p][img src="https://img2.tapimg.net/post/images/a42d17672a4dc2e798cbbf3a3dfb274f.png?imageMogr2/thumbnail/1080x9999%3E/quality/80/format/jpg/interlace/1/ignore-error/1&t=1"][/img][/p][p](2) As mentioned in the [b]Time Mechanic[/b], characters will begin to suffer from continuous environmental damage after 120 seconds of battle. Therefore, it's recommended to bring [b]Moderator Audhum[/b] to ensure some degree of sustain. Its AOE healing benefits the entire team, significantly increasing overall survivability.[/p][p][img src="https://img2.tapimg.net/post/images/4a0fcffb82c3041f7bda4157ddbf345c.png?imageMogr2/thumbnail/1080x9999%3E/quality/80/format/jpg/interlace/1/ignore-error/1&t=1"][/img][/p][p]Besides [b]Audhum[/b], other Soul Cores like [b]The Saint (Fire)[/b], [b]Ymir the Origin (Thunder)[/b], [b]The Goddess of Youth (Poisonous)[/b], and [b]Chaos[/b] can also provide sustained healing, so you can choose the right combination based on your setup.[/p][p][/p][h3][b]II. Gear Build[/b][/h3][p][/p][p](1) In addition to traditional resistance-reducing Soul Cores, new gear affixes have been added that reduce enemy resistance. In Version 2.2, the newly introduced [b]Myriad Casket[/b] feature allows Mythic gear to be upgraded into [b]Immortal[/b] gear with set bonuses (upgrade materials can be obtained via the [i]Astral Expedition[/i] mode). Notably, the [b]Teal Goldscale Helm Set[/b] grants a 2-piece bonus [b]that reduces enemy all-elemental resistance by 18% upon entering combat.[/b][/p][p][/p][p][b]Tips:[/b] If your gear has an [b]Ancient Affix[/b] like “Required set pieces for XX set bonus -1”, then you only need one piece of the set to activate the 2-piece effect.[/p][p][img src="https://img2.tapimg.net/post/images/1b9ff154397af82b7f7e4d6111c54f09.png?imageMogr2/thumbnail/1080x9999%3E/quality/80/format/jpg/interlace/1/ignore-error/1&t=1"][/img][/p][p](2) The set mentioned above can be relatively difficult to obtain in the early stages of the version due to material shortages. For players lacking resources, consider this newly added Immortal accessory from [b]Orisols I Shop[/b]: the [b]Molten Worldscorch Ring[/b]. This piece comes with a built-in affix that reduces the enemy’s all-elemental resistance by 8%. It only costs [b]50,000 Co-op Badges.[/b][/p][p][img src="https://img2.tapimg.net/post/images/a00631e336044f7c6a5eed2cbf0f8514.png?imageMogr2/thumbnail/1080x9999%3E/quality/80/format/jpg/interlace/1/ignore-error/1&t=1"][/img][/p][h3][b]III. Controlling[/b][/h3][p][/p][p]Since [b]environmental damage[/b] reduces both [b]HP and stamina[/b], careless actions may result in stamina not recovering properly. It’s recommended to get into the habit of frequently using [b]Soul Shard[/b].[/p][p][/p][p][b](1) Soul Shard System[/b][/p][p]When a character uses a skill, it consumes stamina and leaves behind a red [b]Soul Shard gauge[/b] in the stamina bar. If the character avoids taking damage during this time, a [b]yellow Soul Shard recovery bar[/b] will appear.
While the yellow bar is still visible, performing actions like [b]weapon switch or dodge[/b] will trigger a [b]Soul Shard[/b], instantly restoring stamina equal to the yellow portion of the bar.[/p][p][img src="https://img2.tapimg.net/post/images/3b6c239400c6da3d1af29e48cd2dd4f8.png?imageMogr2/thumbnail/1080x9999%3E/quality/80/format/jpg/interlace/1/ignore-error/1&t=1"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][b](2) Affix[/b][/p][p]In addition to quickly restoring stamina, Soul Shard can also be enhanced with equipment affixes such as [b]“Restore HP when Soul Shard is triggered”[/b], further improving sustain.[/p][p][img src="https://img2.tapimg.net/post/images/aa77a67f2ae465a6723767c998950d66.png?imageMogr2/thumbnail/1080x9999%3E/quality/80/format/jpg/interlace/1/ignore-error/1&t=1"][/img][/p][p][b]More Way To Connect:[/b][/p][p][url="https://t.me/+UTeJzzXVJG45YzEx"]★★★ Telegram ★★★[/url][/p][p][url="https://chat.whatsapp.com/BcrAnML6YLt3YCQsmELzAH"]★★★ WhatsAPP ★★★[/url][/p][p][url="https://bladeofgodx.wiki.gg/wiki/"]★★★ Official Wiki ★★★[/url][/p][p][/p][p]

notes.title: 2025/07/03 Update
notes.content:
v2.2 Updated: The Dusky Bloodline

New Class - Chaos the Warrior
- This advanced class unlocks at level 25. ""Chaos the Warrior"" joins the battle wielding hammer-based, strike-focused weapons and skills.

New Game Mode - Astral Expedition
- Astral Expedition: A time-limited mode where Inheritors can form squads within their Caravan to challenge a brand-new boss — Darkvein Adiposer.

New Soul Core - Frozen Illusion of Divinity
- A brand-new Ice elemental, Soul Core “Balder The God of Light” is now available. It provides stable critical damage and solo Affinity, boosting all team attributes. The Supreme version drops exclusively from the time-limited Astral Expedition.
- Ice element Soul Core series is now fully added, including
“Loki The Evil,” “Cthylla The Frostwyrm,” “Kraken The Sea Monster,” and “Hydra The Deep Diver.”

New Cultivation - Myriad Casket
- Inheritors can now construct four Ancient affixes and preserve the exclusive affixes from the Mythic equipment, then ascend the Mythic equipment into Immortal Sets.

New Transmog - Crimson Curse of Immortality
- Character sets:
Hela “Crimson Moon Reverie,” Esther “Phantasmal Night's Allure,” Chaos “Lord of Eternal Night”
- Nephesh: “Nightmare Beast”
- Weapons: “Crimsonwing Blade,” “Phantomwing Pistol,” “Scythe of Judgment”

New Chapter - Fragments of Gladsheim
- Chapter Trurem 6-5 unlocks, World Progress, chapter task, Yggdrasil Blessing and more are available.

Optimizations - New Buds on the Yggdrasil
- A new ""Free Cast"" mode has been added; Inheritors can switch controlling modes in the Skill interface.
- A new ""Entity Illusion"" Willpower Leaderboard has been added; Inheritors can check their current Willpower rankings in the Thought Amulet interface.
- New ""Entity Illusion"" option button for sorting Solo/Co-op Silver Keys.
- New ""Entity Illusion"" feature: Skip battles and directly claim rewards from Solo keys tier 1 to 3 (no Privilege required).
- New Mythical Blueprint exchanges have been added to the Campaign Shop.
- Added a preview feature for the Thought Amulet, including estimated Willpower drops.
- Weekly and Monthly Pass daily rewards have been expanded — Inheritors can now choose additional rewards beyond the default ones.
- Improved display of Privileges in both leaderboard and chat interfaces.
- Optimized the main story boss challenges — after death, Inheritors can now use the “Spring of Revival” item to resurrect and continue the battle.
- Improved combat experience for certain class skills (including fixing abnormal skill range issues for Esther and adjusting the combat feel of some skills).
...and many other detailed improvements...

...and many other detailed improvements.

notes.title: V2.1 Guide: The Hidden Treasure Chest - Full Star Collecting Maps
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45149847/939dcc999e10df561d78bf2cd78633782f4483e3.png[/img]
[h1]Introduction[/h1]

In Blade of God, collecting all the chests within each level is a key factor in achieving a three-star rating in the main storyline. Accumulated stars can be exchanged in the Explore Gift section for generous rewards, including large amounts of Soul Stones and Orisols Scrolls.

Some players have reported difficulty locating certain hidden chests in specific levels. To assist with that, we've prepared this illustrated guide to help you track down all hidden chests and ensure a full clear.

[h1]Voidom[/h1]
[h2]3-4 Underground[/h2]
There are a total of 8 chests at this level. The map is large. If you're unsure where to go, refer to this map to help guide your direction.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45149847/be97649637c642751c6c5c0918dae10acb3da00b.png[/img]

From the Initial Point, head to the right. You'll find the first chest in front of a coffin. Next, turn right again and walk behind the rocks to discover the second chest.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45149847/033f711350fbfc4042c35679e9c76f4fedf9ea0c.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45149847/32c173fbc44956a55f7738b5ea040bb1a12e4a3d.png[/img]
Return to the Initial Point, and you’ll find the third chest next to a skeleton just ahead.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45149847/1a5bf4196ee4c1268f5db22fc8d2d08decafd7c5.png[/img]

Move behind the skeleton, and behind the rock on the rear left side, you’ll locate the fourth chest.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45149847/845ac0fd53a77cb3a7649484f0c47a9df2c7ceb3.png[/img]
Turn around and walk straight back, you'll spot the fifth chest ahead. Keep moving forward through the fog, and you’ll come across two more chests.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45149847/97a45e1c52d6f1d2c4f8118f52a7d1546499ec48.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45149847/9848c78cd008278bce62aead1497ecea0d23b035.png[/img]
Finally, turn around and walk straight to the end of the path. Once you reach the mushroom forest, turn left—you’ll find the eighth and final chest hidden inside.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45149847/49117e93f3c45e5d7e53e19a0a92a9b5d176ed99.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45149847/16ab8f598756946cd74a2c472752ee6d45460f54.png[/img]
[h2]4-3 Black Tomb[/h2]
There are a total of 4 chests at this level. Right behind the Initial Point, you'll find the first chest hidden behind a mushroom.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45149847/a181952d9a8d319d8d8c5838c0bccef60662d5e7.png[/img]
Continue moving forward, next to the Hugroots, you’ll find the second chest. Keep going ahead and walk through the fog.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45149847/991ca96b25ddfb94c93c1b35ac5556dd7c1944dc.png[/img]
After passing through the fog, the third chest ahead. Then, head into the fog on the right.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45149847/560080fdc80874af92bb0c7b3e65ecf545275a26.png[/img]

Once through, you can find the fourth chest.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45149847/cac31983ea141e8eebd9dca7531bd1fe91022e1b.png[/img]
[h2]4-4 Dark Forest[/h2]
There are total of 5 chests in the level, and you can refer this map to help you find the direction. The first chest in front of the Initial Point.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45149847/c464747713bdb6be666c28a24a4c1e5a204d0499.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45149847/e73d5fb5c07bea145ca20b5ccbbe842906243868.png[/img]

Continue following the path and you'll come across the second chest. Then, take a left turn onto the narrow trail on the left side.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45149847/aa82b2946619d6992dbe4b06cfeb670fa486c279.png[/img]
In front of the Hugroots, you’ll find one chest. Then pass the Hugroots and turn left to find a chest further ahead.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45149847/c08e3ae781d3536d8ee7586acf4388abad506d4d.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45149847/6c2d2259f8a929a5443ae417a4368e07a6d46b29.png[/img]
Keep walking forward. In the clearing at the far end, you’ll find the fifth chest.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45149847/c22f65c92b768f59d20d143522a1324176e5bb72.png[/img]
[h2]5-1 Brave Gate[/h2]
There are total of five chests in the level, there are two chests in front of Initial Point.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45149847/728567a5cc369162d3c94ad02a3934a6e165e1ea.png[/img]
And then follow this guide map, you can find three chests in the maze.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45149847/d4f445b20d6e4dd02009250d9a3e2411519070bb.png[/img]
[h2]5-5 Hringham[/h2]
There are a total of five chests at this level. At the entrance, you can see three chests.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45149847/d8eb3bb0d064e0068a66dd1e353d2101df693b02.png[/img]
Passing through the fog on the right, you'll find the fourth chest.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45149847/7bd38f0cc141c3db16c613aef89ff681ca2eedf2.png[/img]

After defeating the enemies near Chest 1 and opening it, the fifth chest will appear in front of the stairs.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45149847/b984c4217a429591430a39907bc9b77bab423b09.png[/img]
[h1]Primglory[/h1]
[h2]1-2 Elevator[/h2]
There are a total of 8 chests at this level. At the Initial Point, there is one chest. After defeating the enemies, choose the middle Gate 2.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45149847/2ea1f10dce95c8e5ac41a1f61e2626b3d83d6566.png[/img]
In the second area, you’ll find one chest. After defeating the enemies, go through the left Gate 1.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45149847/51d509d307f00740eab889efdea248a450e4377f.png[/img]
In the third area, there is one chest located beyond the final gate.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45149847/5bc732b26bda934ed275d50af0c096d6a5dbd59a.png[/img]
In front of the Hugroots, you’ll find the remaining five chests.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45149847/bf1169a4aa9d219bd66f30996eb41b35733c791e.png[/img]
[h2]2-1 Portal[/h2]
There are a total of four chests at this level, following this map if you lose your direction. At the Initial Point, the first chest is located ahead. Then, turn right and pass through the fog.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45149847/b0296175e1fac9e32f579a7ea4c099fdf7e3a00b.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45149847/70d88e2d9a5cb269905aa2f5621ef785f28865ee.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45149847/cc50215f018e92a0dcd5f3c5908848849ee0272b.png[/img]

Beyond the fog, in the square, you’ll see the second chest. Keep walking forward and deeper into the area to find the third chest at the far end.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45149847/dbcf085b9fbfae23f14682de7c6188a1efc30815.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45149847/bcfb85410d7d4633df516c62f4a8df017343e565.png[/img]
After that, back to the main path. In front of the Hugroots, you’ll find the fourth chest.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45149847/1f20bb120c6f03ca2d8ed3fb638e223db8c07275.png[/img]

There are a total of 5 chests in this level. After entering the level, first turn right and take the narrow path. Along this path, there is the first chest by the roadside. Refer to the position map to find the direction.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45149847/548fe3863d88a32aea0cc52030f259311a8a54ad.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45149847/0749adc9247aa13e18d86740cb210c45905c1377.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45149847/369a0cbf588507d83a0656b5e19430cdd70a6a5d.png[/img]
Continue following the narrow path and you’ll find two more chests along the way.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45149847/a73970730db040f0d4169f55b8be2ee107f6d2fc.png[/img]
Next, head to the square where the Hugroots are located, you’ll find the remaining two chests on the right side.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45149847/42b2801821c9930648ac225cc0d8313eae551899.png[/img]
[h2]3-1 Dead Waters[/h2]
There are a total of 4 chests at this level. At the Initial Point, turn right to find the first chest. Defeat the two enemies here to unlock a new gate.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45149847/d9409ef8fab83ac9fde35d76150a96db02fa69a0.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45149847/af40da4ea075ac9977b91dab4519b034735d532a.png[/img]
Then, follow the guidance forward to find the fourth chest ahead.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45149847/62fb2859fa08b8b4fe451a6ed0e32dcc52008816.png[/img]
[h2]3-2 Black Lagoon[/h2]
There are a total of 7 chests in this level. The map is quite large and contains several puzzle activation points. Refer this map to find directions. At the Initial Point, activate the glowing pillar, then walk forward.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45149847/5cf2caf8415ee3ffac8811c683824ed829e9997d.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45149847/9bd6b24ee57199bccfb47d1089eca01a5193ef26.png[/img]

You’ll find the first chest in the central area. From the chest, turn right and activate the two glowing pillars. Then follow the path near the left pillar deeper into the map. You'll find two chests inside. Defeat enemies to unlock the third chest.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45149847/073f3d5996392ddc517653a2c0e7cbbfa6467dae.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45149847/a720cf64ecc63b12df6b965fff48a0ddfa7ae78f.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45149847/e2a2f136e1eca65ed01625a44ec45dd7511bb6fc.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45149847/8b64346d6ab5507137ed2594af83d3de12109113.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45149847/dab90d8ef11c51983b3d94dccc90a5e4c2cd29d6.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45149847/09152c5afeea7179f3a876a2bdfcd309db6874cc.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45149847/c8ae076a1c8c44ee05ecce1d4c1a5adfcac32dc6.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45149847/f787e5c909829c10ba293babf598aedb9f075957.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45149847/fc7fbb955bf47fad91dbf054a17d55dec56ca80f.png[/img]

There are six chests in the map, you turn right from the Initial Point and there are two chests hehind the enemiey.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45149847/0a378fe5dcf899f71dc723dfbd2cf511cf48f02c.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45149847/9488d1a0350e71932f2c9629e5f4992b00d8fecf.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45149847/36f38ac96c17c38b29930f60fd100589c4c4ac67.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45149847/3b7a445f6698d037b62d4ba16633dc3bf01da06c.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45149847/cc4eae1a197f337c4dbf4fba5aa21bd2eb0c5443.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45149847/d3f26ce77c7cdde8558c079f76a3cb3baa3fa505.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45149847/9897a1f4304c96036801e2e983c956bdd4337b11.png[/img]

[h2]1-1 Scorching Anvil[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45149847/4db8e0abc25f8a748ecde606e69fa94ad9d61de3.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45149847/63d11e46f81c219d882b49b18aec78d65fc12c78.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45149847/5d208b9997f14bc6ffdee2531df37bbbd66b366a.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45149847/ce96ee67332dd392970a04979971c9bd30c4e929.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45149847/77c7ccf594c8e760b63e5cdf509f1ac54e58dfcd.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45149847/07379453edd9bf33daaa7731ffefef321a3f5196.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45149847/e24aad5f16961c2eb022e8e6dceef2abadf9ad6b.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45149847/2f5d3586ea7ea3cb409462b2a2e809ea90c78a10.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45149847/3ab9b27c1b2bf29ccab66de6c12232eb515c0ed7.png[/img]

notes.title: V2.1 Guide: Advanced Cultivation - High Crit Based On Soul Cores & Gears
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45149847/bf2f7557d33db88c521fab3fcde31492229a0f18.png[/img]

[h1]Four Elemental Debuffs[/h1]

How do you release all four elemental debuffs effects to the enemies? It’s easy in co-op mode, each teammate has a weapon of a different element to cover all four. In solo mode, you’ll always trigger your primary-element debuff but still need the other three. 

You can rely on your armor’s ancient affix [when you cast a skill, having a chance to apply a random elemental debuff to the target], but it is too random, a more reliable way is to take different Soul Cores of each elemental debuff (using Soul Core Substitution function to preserve affinity completion), and then use their [b]Skill 1's elemental damage[/b] to apply the debuffs. Here are a few Soul Cores that are renowned for their strong sole capabilities:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45149847/59594dcf9928ab5a48f0356cd1dee385c38b8833.png[/img]

[b]Fire: The Dragon of the End[/b] (Mythic) and [b]The Bombardment[/b] (Primal) both have the same skill 2 Extreme Blade, which boosts your ATK, making them incredibly versatile and easy to slot into almost any build.
[b]Ice: The Deep Diver[/b] (Primal) delivers massive CD reduction in the early stage, letting you cycle light-and-heavy-weapon skills easily. The Deep Diver will lose elemental-damage boost on Skill 2, but their other benefits are enough to make up for that trade-off.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45149847/85ac06734ca01f4dff2f7008155f7c82e5e44bec.png[/img]

[b]Thunder: The Allfather[/b] (Mythic) and [b]The Immortal[/b] (Primal), both “Odin” variants with broad applicability. The Allfather is the essensial for crit-based builds based on its third-skill’s huge critical-damage buff, while The Immortal gives you Extreme Blade on Skill 2 and a general elemental improves on Skill 3, so it very worthy to take.
[b]Poison:[/b] [b]The Monster Wolf[/b] (Mythic), [b]The Wise One[/b] (Primal), [b]Ymir Shell [/b](Primal), and [b]The Goddess of Youth[/b] (Mythic). Monster Wolf and Wise One both have Extreme Blade on Skill 2, Ymir Shell is essential for triggering crit, and Goddess of Youth offers sustained recovery, which is suitable for the early stage.

[b]Summary:[/b] Take The Dragon of the End, The Deep Diver, The Allfather, and Ymir Shell to reliably trigger all four elemental debuffs.

[h1]Other Soul Core Choices[/h1]

- [b]The God of the Moon. Lezard: [/b]As an essential Poisonous Soul Core, previous guide pointed out that Poisonous Core suffered from a lack of DMG reduced RES, but now with Lezard filling that gap。 I’ll revisit full Poisonous core recommendation in more detail later.
- [b]The Moderator & The Goddess of Fertility:[/b] Both received a enhancement to their Skill 1 damage, just be aware that their skill range is fairly small, so you’ll want to release them right next to your target for maximum effect.

[h1]Gears & Sets Suggestions [/h1]

[i][b]Abstract: Optional upgrade; not mandatory.[/b][/i]

[h2]“Chalky Sacred” Set[/h2]

This set is got from the [b]“Warrior Co-op: Cold Ice. Ancestor Shell” dungeon, Level 60(40)[/b]. 

Its four-piece bonus grants +15 % Critical Rate and +40 % Critical Damage; and, its base stats as same as the previous version’s Level 60 (10) Melted Iron Best-in-Slot gear, with the sole addition of 16 % All-elemental Damage Reduction. Consider the current version, pervasive damage overflow, this set is by no means a required upgrade. However, if you already possess three Mythic or Immortal gear with the “Set-1” affix, you may consider replacing the fourth piece with a [b]Chalky Sacred gear[/b] to secure the extra Crit Damage boost.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45149847/022fd2d8a2e82f3995054ab9d71e8824d735a23b.jpg[/img]

[h2]“Blood Spirit Oath” Set[/h2]

[b]Got from the (Warrior Co-op – Thunderstorms. Skoll) dungeon, Level 60(40). [/b]

Its four-piece bonus grants +5 % Attack and +22 % All Elemantal DMG. Although this set sounds generally useful, now we already have [b]Twisted Meteor[/b] and [b]Abyssal Prism[/b], which increase higher sustain and DMG. The Nephesh slot is replaced by the Mythic [b]Thunder Spirit Fox[/b], offering extreme increasing skill-damage, and the skill level improve. So, the Blood Spirit Oath Set sees almost no use once those alternatives are available and is recommended only as a short-term choise for new players until they secure Best-in-Slot gear.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45149847/0758a743731ecabeba79c96e11b1a7ab6ded0eff.jpg[/img]

[h2]Mythic Gear[/h2]

[i][b]Abstract: It is recommended to reroll weapon affixes to optimize their attributes.[/b][/i]

[b]Light and Heavy Weapons[/b]
- Compared to the previous version, the basic fixed affixes have received only marginal increases—insufficient to affect overall balance.

[b]However, this update introduces a new ancient affix which changed the game:[/b]

[b]Light Weapons (Best-in-Slot Affix Combination):[/b] Critical Damage increase, Critical Damage increase Against Debuffed Targets ,Light Weapon Skill Level Increase.
[b]Heavy Weapons (Best-in-Slot Affix Combination)[/b]: Critical Damage increase, Heavy Weapon Skill Level Increase, Attack or Elemental Damage increase.

[h2]Chaos Slot[/h2]

- In high-output scenarios, [b]Storm Heart[/b] outperforms [b]Twisted Meteor[/b].
- Although Twisted Meteor was the Best-in-Slot chaos in the previous version, based on its exceptional sustain. However, by the introduction of the [b]Talent—Fearless Warrior[/b] and unlocked cooldown-reduction attributes has greatly eased sustained concerns.
- So, [b]Storm Heart[/b] can be chosen as a transitional choice until you get higher-tier Immortal chaos.

[b]Immortal Gear[/b]

[i][b]Abstract: Strongly recommend to choose and rerolling the affixes.[/b][/i]

Chaos Slot – [b]Abyssal Prism[/b]
- Its permanent Critical Damage increase is very useful in the current version, where cooldown pressure is no longer an issue in the current version.
- For players with insufficient Critical Rate, its 18 % Critical Rate increase is also useful.
Recommended Affixes: Increases skill damage when releasing skills, Increases critical rate and critical damage upon entering combat” (new in this version).

[h1]Soul Core Build Recommendations for Each Elemental Style[/h1]

For detailed strategies, please read my previous guide. This summary follows the same foundation; the only adjustment is to choose new Soul Cores based on your current Crit Rate (e.g., have you over 100%?). 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45149847/e8bb767d5df0efb2eb3b67d4dafb0e394958f6d4.png[/img]

[h2]Fire Soul Core Affinities[/h2]

Unlocking [b]Talent III[/b] greatly relaxes cooldown constraints on fire skills. By taking the [b]Solar Eclipse [/b]and [b]Divine Blaze[/b] affinity, you maximise your damage output, though these affinities need time to gradually stack its damage increase during combat and is not burst damage output.

- [b]Solar Eclipse:[/b] The Dragon of the End + The Sun Goddess
- [b]Divine Blaze:[/b] The Mortal Snake + The Bombardment
- [b]Judgment of Demonic Flame:[/b] The Lawvataine Creator + The Filthy Demon (equip The Filthy Demon in your soul core substitution)
- [b]Elegy of Nibelungen:[/b] The Solemn + The Dragonslayer (equip The Dragonslayer in soul core substitution; The Solemn serves as the reduction anchor and should at the front of skill combo)
- [b]Crossroads of Fate:[/b] Amorphous Eyes + The Tyrant

[h2]Substitution Affinities[/h2]

 Depending on your needs, you can add Substitution Affinities:
- [b]War of Gods[/b] (Final Damage increase)
- [b]Ancestral Frost[/b] (Attack Power increase; note that Fire’s Attack buffs may dilute this effect)

You may also choose any of these Soul Cores into your Soul Core substitution for sustain or Crit Damage increase. They all provide similar performances:
The Saint (sustain) / The Monster Wolf (sustain) / The Immortal (Crit increase) / The Wise One (sustain) / Audhum / The Warrior (sustain + Crit Damage)


[h2]Thunder Soul Core Affinity[/h2]

Thunder Soul Core has the highest damage ceiling among the four elements, but they rely on the Rune Whisper and requirement of Crit Rate.

- [b]War of the Gods:[/b] The Allfather + The God of Thunder (The God of Thunder as the core of Thunder RES Reduction, place at the front of your Skill Combo.)
- [b]A Knight’s Dream:[/b] The Goddess of Fertility + The Immoral Knight (After adjusted. The Goddess of Fertility can be equipped directly.)
- [b]Ancestral Frost:[/b] Ymir Shell + Ymir The Origin

[h2]Additional Support Affinities:[/h2]

- [b]Divine Blaze:[/b] The World Serpent + The Bombardment （High ATK increase）
- [b]Elegy of Nibelungen:[/b] The Solemn + The Dragonslayer （Gian high ATK after dodging）

[h2]Recommended Soul Core Substitutes:[/h2]

The Dragon of the End / The Dragonslayer / The Monster Wolf / The Wise One / The Bombardment / Audhum / The Warrior (sustain + Crit Damage)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45149847/e8bb767d5df0efb2eb3b67d4dafb0e394958f6d4.png[/img]

[h2]Poisonous Soul Core Affinity[/h2]

[b]Amorphous Havoc[/b] (The Amorphous Soul+The Wise One) Decent final DMG+huge Crit rate provides huge advantage in the early stage, also the soul skill of Hela can make a realm range to prevent flying attacks, which does amazing help in Caravan Co-op

[b]Soulbane Fenrir[/b] (The Monster Wolf+The Devil Lord) The passive skill of affinity is not impressive, but the sole Soul Core has good performance. The character will have a long invincible period when the active affinity is triggered, which helps the character who lacks that.

[b]Forbidden Fantasy[/b] (The Goddess of Youth+The Mistmon) Key output affinity, The Mistmon itself is not impressive, but The Goddess of Youth has a high recovery function, suggested to but it on the Break skill button.

The God of the Moon itself is also a key one to reduce the enemy's resistance. Please put it in the front of the skill chain. The Warrior can support Hela's affinity, build a fast first stage of Crit hit.

[h2]Extra Affinity[/h2]

You may equip an extra affinity. Recommended options include the [b]Divine Blaze affinity[/b] (high ATK), [b]Elegy of Nibelungen[/b] (granting great ATK boosts after dodging), or the [b]Ancestral Forest[/b] affinity (which offers high basic attack, also the Ymir Shell is a Poisonous one already). notes.title: V2.1 Guide: Soul Stone Strategy - Over 30000 In Month One
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45149847/34d89215427b6e16c7a9b53e03c43dfb14a80eea.png[/img]

[h1]First of all[/h1]
This guide will take you through the way you can get Soul Stone as a beginner in the first month, ensuring you maximize your game efficiency and get Soul Stone as much as possible.

Tips: Before we begin, I strongly recommend that all new players master the main story mode and level up to 60. Completing the main story mode not only unlocks new features and dungeons but also obtains lots of Soul Stone rewards.

[h1]Powering the Main Story Mode and Level Up[/h1]

[h2]1. Explore Gift[/h2]

When you are clearing the main story quests, you must notice there are some treasure boxes on the map. Try to explore the map and open all the boxes to earn a three-star rating, which is essential for your Explore Gifts. By the time you unlock Voidom Chapter 6-5, usually right around level 60 in your first month. You can get at least 3910 Soul Stones from Explore Gift if you've earned 180 stars in previous chapters.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45149847/27e9d115466da6c07cee1328484f88c6bcb903e7.jpg[/img]

[h2]2. World Stat Award[/h2]

You can award [b]2300 Soul Stones[/b] in total from world stats. After you complete Voidom chapters 2-5 and 4-5 each grants 500 and 1000 Soul Stones. And completing Primglory chapter 1-5 for another 800 Soul Stones.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45149847/b6d5a4ebd901901ca47d693e4812b13f10d1b367.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45149847/ed1398c5b085e935a03319bb3a0a315d2f89a2e4.jpg[/img]

[h2]3. Level Fund[/h2]

Don’t forget the Level Fund in your Mail. Reaching level 60 awards 600 Soul Stones (12 tiers × 50 stones each). After level 60, additional tiers unlock more stones—claim them as soon as they become available.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45149847/ac66b2f99c08906b9971df7c7f62c3fc225f1c61.jpg[/img]

[b]Summary: [/b]Following the main story queatline and hitting level 60 within your first month, you'll get at least [b]6810 Soul Stones.[/b]

[h1]Tasks and dungeons[/h1]

[h2]1. Daily Task[/h2]

Every day in Blade of God X you have a chance to earn Soul Stones. Completing daily tasks grants 150 Soul Stones. I recommend farming the daily dungeon first to quickly boost your activity, then returning to the quest menu to claim your rewards. In the early stages, before all dungeons are unlocked, replaying main-story chapters also fills your activity effectively.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45149847/ae03b074d18ff2314da3ec3e28279b8d93c75212.jpg[/img]

[h2]2. Battle Pass Daily Quests[/h2]

While completing Daily Quests, you’ll simultaneously tick off your Battle Pass daily quests. You earn [b]120 Soul Stones[/b] once your daily reputation reaches 400, and push that Battle Pass all the way to level 76 within the month, and you’ll have another [b]320 stones[/b].

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45149847/8e2b994ca2f32dfe0f6e118c8c2cacd6f72cf2c5.jpg[/img]

[h2]3. God Arena[/h2]

Once the Book of Adventure unlocks the God Arena, you can earn Soul Stones there. You have three challenges per day, each awarding [b]20–50 stones[/b] depending on the level you choose. I recommend new players start with levels 1 and 2 for practice and only attempt level 3 once you are familiar with it.
Each level of God Arena has its own leaderboard. You can try to crack the top 5000 rank on each one and get [b]300 stones[/b] per season (two weeks), for a total of [b]900 stones[/b].

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45149847/327c99f883b778d12625681b3752ba309f7f2dfd.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45149847/46044b4d76fb9a0dbebbc37d3e9e25d2287e931d.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45149847/265ce4a2ad10f09ccc855c3128f0eadc98509965.jpg[/img]

[h2]4. Two Souls[/h2]

As a new player, you won’t spend much time in Two Souls; just play a few rounds and make sure you are in the top 9999 rank. Every season (two weeks) rewards 50 Soul Stones.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45149847/45d16cc994347d9a161b671c0099f60f950acc11.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45149847/36dcb001f1ff7b5d6c94ee763372c9936041d106.jpg[/img]

[h2]5. Old Arena[/h2]

Meanwhile, Old Arena as a daily task—ten victories will quickly push you into Platinum rank, and Platinum rewards [b]225 Soul Stones[/b], and a season rewards of 400 stones

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45149847/4f4fc4e4953c98325e5595f6f5dc7807440d7298.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45149847/b4bf96cb90830deb230fb7290a01720345cb2aa1.jpg[/img]

[h2]6. Combat Training[/h2]

Don’t forget the Combat Training in Book of Adventure; the first clear on each chapter can get [b]275 stones[/b] in total.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45149847/985e2e69ccccbb90d757dc505121fd33817edc7e.jpg[/img]


[b]Summary:[/b] Putting it all together, you can get a total of [b]420 Soul Stones[/b] every day from daily tasks, Battle Pass daily quests, and God Arena. Add in your monthly season rewards, [b]1,800 Soul Stones[/b] from God Arena rank, [b]100 Soul Stones[/b] from Two Souls rank, and [b]313 Soul Stones[/b] from the Old Arena, and you’re looking at over 15,300 Soul Stones just in [b]ONE MONTH!!!![/b]

[h1]Events and Daily Check-In[/h1]

[h2]1. Check-In[/h2]

Each day you log in to the game, you can claim your daily check-in reward. If you sign in for 28 days in a month, you will receive [b]600 Soul Stones.[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45149847/c176a2a8b67be4278392803e87447875e84e3218.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45149847/e492a5857e09bc600d9340ec6c4cd5c9e3cf92e7.jpg[/img]

[h2]2. Privilege[/h2]

You can also receive [b]5 Soul Stones[/b] daily from the Privilege Daily Gift Pack in the Mall.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45149847/159bfc197c405ede9fe87a3612b589b910afc705.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45149847/d3532265bc4c2ccc9036462648f546ac2d50834b.jpg[/img]

[h2]3. Join in Community[/h2]

Join the official Telegram or WhatsApp community groups to claim [b]100 Soul Stones[/b], and don’t forget to subscribe to the game on Steam and leave a comment for another [b]50 stones[/b].

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45149847/b8880844fa01b09e13db23b404b2e6d2b1c6235f.jpg[/img]

[b]Summary:[/b] Attend daily check-in and events to receive 850 Soul Stones at least a month.

[h1]Top-up[/h1]

[h2]1. Unlock Orisols Pass[/h2]

To unlock Orisols pass, you can get another 2400 Soul Stones when you pass level reaching 76.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45149847/d8caf7a84b1e75af29bc6337c78fcd6f19e10482.jpg[/img]

[h2]2. Weekly Pass[/h2]

Obtaining a weekly pass can receive [b]1000 Soul Stones[/b] every week.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45149847/2d3e4575f1f8659d12a8125bec52897e454e398b.jpg[/img]

[h2]3. Top-Up Bonus[/h2]

Finally, when you make your first top-up in the Soul Jade store, you can get extra Soul Stones bonus upon your first time Soul Jade Recharge.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45149847/7a847bdc942ec3042c140c922f07813221d6a9b8.jpg[/img]

notes.title: V2.1 Guide: Entity Illusion - Battle Strategy & Item Guide
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45149847/20959566ca346a6c1f9ba6d65888e7d6ac4cf2b8.png[/img]
[h1]PART 1: Gameplay[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45149847/1ccba38810a0d068761fb00e68ec5f58944163b3.jpg[/img]
Entity Illusion can be summarized as a cyclical challenge system:
[b]★Use a Key → Complete a battle → Get the Key for the Next Level → Repeat★[/b]
During the cycle, entering a challenge requires meeting a [b]Willpower threshold[/b], which can be increased by collecting [b]Thought Amulet.[/b]
[b]Yellow Signs are the ultimate pursuit in this gameplay[/b], as this gear's stats apply across all game modes. They also have a chance to contain rare and powerful affixes, helping Inheritors boost both Power and damage.

[h1]PART 2: Items[/h1]

Silver Keys serve as tickets to the Entity Illusion and come in two types:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45149847/540681161591ee0a0ebcf2ba866b07cbdc741e4b.jpg[/img]
[b]✦ Solo Tickets[/b]: Usable only by yourself; have a chance to drop a key for the next level.
[b]✦ Co-op Tickets[/b]: You can invite up to two friends to join. [b]Only the host’s ticket is consumed, and no tickets drop in this mode.[/b]
Also, if you fail the challenge, don't worry—the ticket is returned to the Inheritor who didn't complete it.

[h1]PART 3: Suggestions[/h1]

[h2]1. Low-Tier levels Farming Tips[/h2]

Since the ticket drop to the next level is probability-based, it's common to experience ticket shortages around level 3 or 4. This means you’ll need to frequently farm low-tier levels. Solo tickets often require defeating many small mobs, so here are a few ways to improve combat efficiency:

[h3]- Enemy Gathering Skills or Soul Cores:[/h3]
Using enemy gathering skills significantly increases efficiency at low levels.
▶ For example, the Devil Lord’s light weapon skill "Soul Reaping Rift".

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45149847/70a30716e27ff8035137046cf9de124a098702c8.jpg[/img]
- ▶ If you're playing another class without enemy gathering skills, you can use Soul Cores for the same effect; like the “Jormungand. the Mortal Snake” Soul Core. Since Soul Cores don’t provide Willpower and early levels aren’t damage-demanding, you can equip this Soul Core in the first skill or light weapon breaking slot without worrying too much about cultivation.

[h3]- Ultra:[/h3]
Low-tier mobs can usually be cleared from a single Ultra skill, so increasing Ultra frequency boosts farming speed.
▶ Watch for dropped gear with affixes like "Reduced Ultra Energy Requirement", "Faster Ultra Charge", or "Increased Ultra Damage".
▶ Use the Affinity: Audhum + Surtr (level 4). This Affinity allows you to release two Ultras at the beginning of the battle, clearing mobs instantly.
- [b]On certain levels, elite mobs turn into hamster balls to assist you after defeat—consider prioritizing them.[/b]

[h2]2. High-Tier Level Tips[/h2]

[h3]- Remodel Sign Affixes:[/h3]
The higher the level, the lower the chance to drop the next level’s key. Once you get a high-tier solo ticket (Stage 5+ recommended), consider remodeling its affixes:
▶ Go to the main gameplay screen (green interface with keyhole), tap the bottom-left icon to open the Silver Key inventory. Select a Silver Key, then click REMODEL’ to consume Yellow Signs and remodel affixes.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45149847/6365eeef57add0779fdbccc6326ec2bfc2f6bb26.jpg[/img]
▶ For solo tickets, prioritize affixes that [b]boost Silver Key drops[/b].
▶ If you have a lot of Yellow Signs, you can remodel them for key drop affixes. Once the remodel result is good, use [b]Infusion[/b] to enhance affixes values using shards gained from dismantling Amulets.

[h2]3. Team Challenge Tips[/h2]

Since co-op tickets can't drop tickets to the next level, consider refining affixes of [b]Yellow Signs[/b] or [b]Thought Amulet[/b] drops instead.
- If your Willpower is low and you can’t enter mid-to-high level stages, focus on refining the Amulet affixes.
- If your Willpower is decent, refine [b]Yellow Sign drop affixes[/b] more.

[h3]Extra Tips:
[/h3]
- If you have enough Amulet shards, max out your affixes values.
- Since only the host consumes the ticket, consider each player of the 3 provide the ticket rotately to maximize efficiency—or even use alt accounts to provide tickets and farm faster.

[h1]PART 4: Yellow Signs – Efficient Power & Damage Cultivation[/h1]

[h2]1. Collecting Yellow Signs[/h2]

- Early stage, use [b]Epic (purple)[/b] Yellow Signs as a temporary choice.
- Affixes Priority: Focus on [b]DMG[/b] and [b]Final DMG[/b]. If your Crit Rate isn’t at 100%, put priority on Crit Rate too.
- Goal: Primal Yellow Signs can contain the best affixes—[b]Skill Damage Increase[/b]—which should be your primary collection target.
- Tip: Some affixes have negative values (like resistance or elemental damage). These stats are naturally high, so a slight decrease won’t hurt your power much.

[h2]2. Yellow Sign Synthesis[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45149847/4b3a23fc4efd920a8bb20bdf5b4694b012f362d0.png[/img]
- Be cautious, when the Yellow Sign Synthesises. Synthesis only re-combines existing affixes—it doesn’t generate new ones.
- Note: Both parent Signs need to have [b]good affixes[/b]. Synthesis carries risk, so keep a usable backup Sign in case the result isn't ideal, or your power might be affected.

notes.title: v2.1.0 Update Suspension Announcement
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45149847/213e1ec06efb88efa8edc043e718d585eca67328.jpg[/img]
[i]Dear Inheritors,[/i]
In order to provide players with a better gaming experience and improve the playability and interactivity of the game, [h3]we will launch the server update at 13:00PM, April 9th (UTC + 8), with an expected shutdown of 4 hours. [/h3]

After the shutdown update ends, Inheritors can receive [b]the following update reward through in-game emails:[/b]
[u]Orisol Contract *10
Soul Stone *588
Sanity Crystal *10[/u]

[b][h2]I. New Character Esther[/h2][/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45149847/ac55b7ce56bbce88aa868080b8e5300039a662cc.png[/img]
Unlike Chaos and Hela, [b]Esther is a character with long-range offensive capabilities.[/b]
As a Valkyrie who wields firearms to deal damage from a distance, Esther offers a gameplay experience that emphasizes mobility and strategy.
The two newly unlocked classes for this character further diversify the play-style based on the foundation of her long-range combat template; providing a fresh and unique battle experience!

[h3][u][b]Basic Class [Hunter][/b][/u][/h3]
As a Valkyrie, Hunter Esther wields dual guns that can deal damage to large groups of targets, and after completing specific skills, she can perform a teleportation.
The Hunter primarily deals multi-segment physical damage to enemies.

[h3][b][u]Advanced Class [The Saint][/u][/b][/h3]
Esther is not only a noble and beautiful envoy but also a Valkyrie walking the mortal world. Therefore, based on this concept, Esther's golden armor, while maintaining its firm and solemn foundation, incorporates feather-like plates, which transform soft feathers into sharp protective weapons, further emphasizing her identity as a Valkyrie.
The Saint's heavy weapon is a handheld cannon, mainly inflicting Thunder, Fire, and minor physical damage, suitable for continuous area damage.

[b][h2]II. New Game Mode: Entity Illusion & Related Cultivation System[/h2][/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45149847/5d565af60e71c4ff361d63410bb2880f937811ab.png[/img]
[h3][u][b]1.Gameplay Introduction[/b][/u][/h3]
Entity Illusion has 11 levels
Inheritors can use the Silver Key to enter a certain level while consume Sainty 
Chances to obtain 'Yellow Signs', 'Thought Amulets', and 'Silver Keys' of higher levels during the battle

[h3][u][b]2.New Attribute - Willpower[/b][/u][/h3]
Willpower is the exclusive attribute in Entity Illusion, to resist the mental corruption caused by unspeakable beings. It is said that when one's mental energy depletes, they will go mad and lose their sanity, ultimately becoming a sacrifice to Cthulhu
[h3]
[u][b]3.Items Introduction[/b][/u][/h3]
[b]✦ Silver Key ✦ [/b]
The treasure condensed from space-time energy at the heart of the World Tree, the Silver Key requires ‘Willpower’ as a prerequisite for use

The Silver Key is divided into 11 tiers, each capable of transporting the user to a corresponding level of Entity Illusion

The Silver Key comes in two types: single-player and multi-player. The multi-player Silver Key allows the holder to invite two other Inheritors to join the battle together, though the enemies within will also become more powerful

Each Silver Key has random affixes (either debuffs or buffs), Inheritors entering the illusion will be affected by these affixes.

----------------------------

[b]✦ Thought Amulet ✦ [/b]
The Blessing of the World Tree can protect iInheritor from the mental attacks of the unspeakable

The attributes of the Thought Amulet only take effect within Entity Illusion

The higher the quality of the Thought Amulet, the greater the Willpower and attribute bonuses it provides.

Thought Amulets are divided into four categories: Attack, Defense, Life, and Omni. Attack, Defense, and Life types can only be equipped in their corresponding slots, while the Omni one can be equipped in all slots

Thought Amulet can be disam into Amulet Fragments

----------------------------

[b]✦ Yellow Signs ✦ [/b]
An artifact imbued with the essence of Hastur grants the wearer terrifying power

The affixes attached to the Yellow Sign may potentially have negative values

The Yellow Sign can carry multiple same affixes

The higher the quality of the Yellow Sign, the more attribute affixes it can carry

[h3][u][b]4.Other[/b][/u][/h3]
[b]✦ Silver Key Extraction ✦ [/b]
The random buffs/debuffs of the Silver Key can be refined by using the ‘Yellow Sign’

There is a chance to get affixes which are from additional drops or add an extra affix by refining

Higher-quality Yellow Signs have a greater chance of refining affixes for additional drops and are less likely to transform these affixes into ordinary buffs/debuffs

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45149847/bc2c8f23d8078ad29898755cd0008b48bea7758f.png[/img]
Raised under the tutelage of Aesir God, Esther embarked on a journey across the mortal realm with a divine mission as one of the best Valkyrie;
However, the sight of humanity suffering under the torment of fallen gods left an indelible mark on her heart.
[b]Ultimately, manipulated by the gods, she assassinated [Soulbane] Chaos, an act that plunged her into endless torment.[/b]
Summoned by the Dark Colossus, Esther was drawn into the void.
[b]As an Inheritor[/b], guided by Audhum, she now strives to restore the Colossus' Library, driven by a burning desire to redeem her past failure by dedicating to saving the world.

[h2][b]【Gameplay Features】[/b][/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45149847/36ea10a653622871ccf12488df710037f75c159f.png[/img]
Unlike Chaos and Hela, Esther is a character[b] with long-range offensive capabilities.[/b]
As a Valkyrie who wields firearms to deal damage from a distance, Esther offers a gameplay experience that emphasizes mobility and strategy.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45149847/3013a672eb99e13318f0cf045c0380d3b9cca790.png[/img]
The two newly unlocked classes for this character further diversify the play-style based on the foundation of her [b]long-range combat template, providing a fresh and unique battle experience![/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45149847/5a042093011642ab4ad13ff2b7b6bba6f9ae3d05.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45149847/4f47035848ef2b47afd6a25a75782f4493dae004.png[/img]
The wide - range normal attacks of dual pistols combined with the heavy - weapon shotguns are [b]suitable for players who love the exhilarating sense of action.[/b]

[h3][b]★The Saint★[/b][/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45149847/92698cd1c0ebae333a3b72c2dc52ec4b227a93fb.png[/img]
Esther is not only a noble and beautiful envoy but also a Valkyrie walking the mortal world. Therefore, based on this concept, Esther's golden armor, while maintaining its firm and solemn foundation, incorporates feather-like plates, which transform soft feathers into sharp protective weapons, further emphasizing her identity as a Valkyrie.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45149847/5dc0af57296be19c8b19b890b87a1cf93488e6f9.png[/img]
The normal attacks of high - speed dual pistols combined with the powerful output of heavy - weapon

notes.title: 【Developer Diary】Concept Design - Hydra the Deep Diver
notes.content:
Hydra was the queen of an ancient kingdom, married to Cassius. After the downfall of their kingdom, Cassius perished. One day, Hydra learned from a man named "Loki" about the gods' cultivation of an army of heroes to combat the twilight. Fueled by her hatred for the destruction of her kingdom, Hydra submerged herself in the Well of Urd and sacrificed her loyalty.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45149847/7aa6527c00b90932167ec9e501310d62dcaacdf7.png[/img]
Resurfacing from the waters, the queen revealed an enchanting and seductive form. She lurks in the depths of the dark coral reefs and attempts to lure every hero who seeks power from the spring. Those who succumb to her allure vanish without a trace.

It is said that in the corridor leading to the sacrificial grounds in the icy tundra, numerous eerie ice and snow sculptures have been discovered. Within these colossal sculptures, faint human-like figures can be seen through the icy walls.

However, among those who have been enchanted, there are some who remain unaffected by Hydra's seduction, causing her to lose both her arms.

The exiled Fire Giant, Surtr, constructed a massive forge in the Land of Fire. It is said that Surtr once created weapons for the gods within this forge. 

However, he has been repeating the same forging motions for thousands of years, without producing any new works. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45149847/c94a43168d2c70879a53d48e974098a7cc880f8b.png[/img]
The chaos and filth in his hands have been expanding and growing day by day. According to a prophecy, the unfinished Lævateinn in his possession will be the harbinger of "twilight." Countless eyes have been coveting this sword for centuries.

notes.title: 【Developer Diary】Concept Design - Gladsheim
notes.content:
The abode of the Asa Gods, known as the "Divine Realm" among mortals. At the highest point stands the palace of Odin, the King of the Gods - Gladsheim. It is said that Odin gathered almost all the gold in the world to create this magnificent wonder, and when the temple was completed, it emitted a radiance surpassing that of the sun.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45149847/9562aa975a711c999cd39f2cfdeac091dff2bc5d.png[/img]

Located on a plateau in Asgard, closest to the World Tree, it serves as the royal residence of Odin, the King of the Gods. Legend has it that Odin collected nearly all the gold in the world to forge this glorious marvel. When the temple was completed, it emitted a radiance surpassing that of the sun. However, this structure, after being suddenly ravaged by the raging World Tree, now bears a dilapidated appearance akin to twilight. 

The Gladsheim of today remains quiet and weary, resembling a state of death. Since successfully restraining the violent outburst of the World Tree, it seems that the King of the Gods has never set foot outside the palace.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45149847/25f78b74b6550a4ee519fb1c0a8e6a8f1d0144f1.jpg[/img]

notes.title: 【Developer Diary】Concept Design - Cassius, the Ancient King
notes.content:
Cassius is the king of an ancient kingdom and a descendant of the Frost Giants. It is said that Cassius was an ambitious ruler who, upon reaching adulthood, swiftly unified the scattered Frost Giant clans in Jotunheim and established a powerful ancient kingdom. The giant army consolidated by Cassius was undefeated, sweeping through the entire realm of Midgard in less than 15 years, turning it into a paradise for the giants. As a result, Cassius earned the title of "The Tyrant."

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45149847/9b95a60d6eca2daa2095894921a726f4ea25b202.png[/img]
However, this Tyrant led his tribe to embark on a certain plan. By the decree of the king, the ancient kingdom occupied the territories surrounding the Well of Urd and tightly sealed off the spring, forbidding anyone from making wishes there.

Nevertheless, Odin, the King of the Gods, who desired to obtain the ancient prophecies, learned of this and launched an attack on the ancient kingdom. After a year-long war, the mortal flesh of the Tyrant ultimately proved unable to withstand the might of the supreme deity. 

Cassius was defeated, and Odin, having obtained the ancient prophecies from the Well, froze the ancient kingdom and severed its entire territory, along with the spring, from Jotunheim, casting it into the cosmos. 

Thus, the ancient kingdom became an isolated island, embarking on a millennium-long journey of exile with its subjects. The true nature of Cassius's plan may forever remain unknown to future generations.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45149847/750afb698489f4cb4470de63304c3fc185bfd7f0.png[/img]

notes.title: 【Developer Diary】Concept Design - Force Field
notes.content:
The palace of Thor, the God of Thunder, is a magnificent and rugged palace in the sky, constructed from enormous gray and weathered rocks. 

It is said to be pulled and suspended in the air by colossal celestial horses. Within this palace, Thor and his warriors train their martial skills day after day, even incorporating numerous brutal mechanisms.

Over time, due to the constant infusion of divine power from Thor and his offspring, the walls of the palace have taken on a mottled appearance of bluish-gray and charred black, with sections of the walls even exposed due to damage.

notes.title: 【Developer Diary】Concept Design - Thrym the Fallen Knight
notes.content:
Thrym was once the captain of the Black Hound Cavalry in the Ecclesiastical Order. However, he was expelled by the Church due to accusations of having an affair with the Archbishop's daughter, earning him the title of "Fallen Knight." 

It is said that Thrym possessed breathtaking beauty, and any woman who looked into his eyes would fall in love with him. Many individuals even lost everything they had in their pursuit of catching a glimpse of his true face.

As the exiled knight sought to restrain his allure towards women, he donned a mask and rode his beloved black steed, "Sárr," to the Well of Urd. There, he offered his "countenance" as a sacrifice, pleading for the "Gate" to sever his cursed charm. 

After the ritual, Thrym vanished without a trace. Rumors suggest that thereafter, some people caught sight of an otherworldly knight treading upon the waters near the spring.

notes.title: 【Developer Diary】Concept Design - Giants' Park
notes.content:
Once a hunting ground for ancient Frost Giant tribes to hunt gigantic creatures, it eventually became a burial ground for numerous giants. 

It is now littered with decaying colossal skeletal remains, weathered enough to distinguish the different parts of the giants' bodies. These remains have melded with the frozen land of the Giant Kingdom, forming a remarkably unique terrain. 

In this realm of perpetual polar night, the colossal creatures that were ruthlessly hunted down by the gods, now transformed into silent fossils, still retain their agonized and contorted postures.

notes.title: 【Developer Diary 】Concept Design - Alberich the Mistmon
notes.content:
Alberich, the Mistmon who visited the Land of Fire, fell in love with a sea nymph from an ancient kingdom. 

However, he was ultimately betrayed, leading him to sacrifice his own heart to the spring. The spring bestowed upon the Mistmon the power of gold, and he used the golden material to twist off the sea nymph's arm, fashioning it into a weapon that would forever remain by his side.

At last, the cursed gold gradually began to consume Alberich's body, forcing him to seek help from the legendary giant in the forge, Surtr.

notes.title: 【Developer Diary 】Concept Design - Valhalla
notes.content:
[b]This is the battlefield where nameless heroes fight. 
It is the Courageous Corridor that leads to the coming end.[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45149847/55d09b0665f96c9d793b8612b0aac49bfb9fbbb5.png[/img]
Valhalla, the location of its residence, was originally a huge abyss that pierced the World Tree's roots and directly communicated with Midgard: the "Great Void". However, the ark of the gods was stranded and aground in this void by the "Darkness" that surged out of it. Thus, the famous Hall of the Slain was constructed based on the wreckage of the ship.

It is said that the Valkyries who serve the Allfather, the king of gods, would guide the souls of great heroes from the "Great Void" here for endless battles in training for the imminent "Twilight".

notes.title: 【Developer Diary】Character Design - Hela, the Executer
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45149847/7733f51388bcdb3066785a980f416bdef5d5992c.jpg[/img]
Hela, the legendary Queen of the Underworld and the Goddess of Death, presiding over aging and disease. The true appearance of this goddess is said to be incredibly unique, with very few fortunate enough to have glimpsed her countenance, and even fewer surviving to tell the tale. Therefore, we can only speculate about her appearance based on fragments of hearsay.

She obscures half of her face with a cold obsidian mask named "Hilideskailaf," the reason for which remains unknown. The runic symbols that manifest behind her reveal, to a certain extent, her origins and intricate connections to the Aesir deities.

During Hela's incarnation as a guardian spirit, we are unaware of her combat style when facing enemies. Considering that this goddess often takes on a human form, when she first appears in the world of "Blade of God 2," she assumes the guise of a normal human female, carrying only a divine sword crafted from obsidian known as "Himinjög."
